title: Workspace default_artifact_root validation: values must carry a URI scheme or be an absolute path
answers: Creating or editing a workspace with a relative default artifact root like 'team-a' returned success, and experiment artifacts silently landed on the client machine. How is this prevented now?
Which workspace fields go through the default_artifact_root validator on POST /api/3.0/mlflow/workspaces and PATCH /api/3.0/mlflow/workspaces/<name>?
Why does C:team-a or a:b get rejected for a workspace storage path, and why is an absolute local path still accepted?
Where is the check that rejects scheme-less artifact roots for workspaces?
body:
Path: Workspace create and update requests (POST /api/3.0/mlflow/workspaces, PATCH /api/3.0/mlflow/workspaces/<name>) pass default_artifact_root through mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_workspace_default_artifact_root, which every experiment in that workspace inherits as its artifact root.
Rule: After the shared storage-location checks (_validate_optional_workspace_storage_location), reject any trimmed non-empty value where mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme returns an empty scheme and os.path.isabs is false, with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE naming the field. Keep this in the default_artifact_root wrapper, not the shared helper, so trace_archival_config.location keeps its own message and experiment artifact_location behaviour is unchanged.
Symptom: A relative root such as 'team-a' was stored verbatim, so experiments got artifact_location 'team-a/<id>', tracking clients treated it as a local path, and log_artifact/log_model wrote to the client's working directory while the server artifact browser stayed empty with no error.
Constraints: None (field absent) and '' or whitespace (clear the override) behave as before. Absolute local paths such as '/mnt/artifacts' remain valid, mirroring the server-level --default-artifact-root. Single-letter 'schemes' like 'C:team-a' are rejected because get_uri_scheme classifies them as local. Trace archival location is validated by a different function and is not covered by this check.
applies: Workspace create/update validation of default_artifact_root on the tracking server; does not cover experiment-level artifact_location or trace archival location.
says: Logged experiment artifacts are saving to local laptops instead of central workspace storage.
The workspace artifact browser shows nothing even though model logging completed without errors.
Creating a workspace with a relative artifact folder path should trigger a validation error.
Workspace setup rejects storage paths starting with drive letters like a Windows path.
Workspace storage settings must require a valid URI scheme or an absolute directory path.
search: Workspace default_artifact_root validation on POST /api/3.0/mlflow/workspaces and PATCH /api/3.0/mlflow/workspaces/<name> requires values to carry a URI scheme or be an absolute path. In mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_workspace_default_artifact_root, mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme and os.path.isabs reject non-empty trimmed relative values with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE. This prevents relative roots from causing client-side artifact writes while server artifact browsers remain empty, and rejects single-letter prefixes like C:team-a. Absolute local paths, empty strings to clear overrides, and absent fields remain valid, while experiment artifact_location and trace archival location are excluded.
